summary: This House Resolution supports designating September 30, 2025, as "Impact Aid Recognition Day" to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the Impact Aid program, which provides federal funds to school districts affected by a loss of tax revenue due to the presence of tax-exempt federal properties.

scores.thoughts: This resolution supports designating a day to recognize the Impact Aid program, which provides federal funding to local educational agencies. While it doesn't directly change spending, it highlights and celebrates a program that constitutes federal spending on public schools, thus indirectly supporting the concept of such spending.
